product_metadata.title: 2 Pack Kitchen Timers Loud Ring Digital Timers for Cooking Magnetic Pink
features: 2 pack digital kitchen timers with large display and 3 buttones, super easy to read and set up.
Clear and Loud alarm, you will easily be able to hear this alarm in another room, and the alarm will stop auto after 30seconds when you in busy.
Countup / Countdown Timer ---- maximum time is 99 minutes 59 seconds, meet the need of kitchen perfectly, great cooking timer and egg timer.
Magnetic back, retractable stand and hook for hanging, can be positioned in variety of locations, like gange hood, fridge door, table and wall hooks.
Memory Setting: You do not need to set the countsown time every time, it will remeber your last time and you only need to press "ST/SP" button.
